items.title: The Pentagon hosts Logan and Jake Paul
items.summary: The Department of War posted a video of Logan and Jake Paul's visit to the Pentagon "to meet with our warriors." It got 36K likes and 19K replies, while quote posts went far bigger: "holy shit we are all going to die" (343K), "Hawk Tuah really fumbled the bag, she could be Secretary of the Interior by now" (142K) and "Imagine showing this image to someone in 2017" (115K).
items.author: @DeptofWar

post.name: Department of War 🇺🇸
post.text: Last Thursday, we welcomed Logan and Jake Paul to the Pentagon to meet with our warriors.
